_approach: EDMProd's description of the genre in one loop: heavy distorted kick, sharp offbeat hi-hats and a bit of percussion, nothing else. Bar 2 lets a ride creep in on the second half and drops a single open hat and rim skip - the 'new element every 8 bars' logic in miniature. Reference: Klangkuenstler, Nico Moreno, Sara Landry 'Lord of the Land'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
